subject: English
release_scope: RPH only, Units 5–8; independent activities; Activity Book page mapping and dated RPT not claimed

content_standards.1.1: Respond suitably to spoken input for different purposes.
content_standards.1.2: Develop pronunciation, stress, rhythm and intonation through listening.
content_standards.1.4: Understand and respond to spoken stories, visual material and songs or rhymes.
content_standards.2.1: Recognise, remember and comprehend vocabulary and short phrases through reading.
content_standards.3.2: Use appropriate sentence writing and punctuation.
content_standards.3.3: Communicate ideas creatively through suitable media and language.

learning_standards.1.1.1: Listen and give an appropriate response to a stimulus.
learning_standards.1.1.2: Show understanding of short spoken instructions.
learning_standards.1.2.1: Hear and pronounce vocabulary and short phrases.
learning_standards.1.2.2(i): Listen to and sing nursery rhymes.
learning_standards.1.3.1: Respond to everyday conversation with support.
learning_standards.1.3.2(i): Join supported exchanges using basic greetings.
learning_standards.1.3.2(iii): Follow basic classroom directions with support during an exchange.
learning_standards.1.4.1(i): Demonstrate listening comprehension using yes/no responses.
learning_standards.1.4.1(ii): Demonstrate listening comprehension by judging statements true or false.
learning_standards.1.4.1(iii): Demonstrate listening comprehension by answering Wh-questions.
learning_standards.2.1.3: Read and show comprehension of vocabulary and short phrases.
learning_standards.3.1.1: Copy and write familiar sight vocabulary legibly.
learning_standards.3.2.1(i): Use lowercase letters correctly in sentences.
learning_standards.3.2.1(ii): Use uppercase letters correctly in sentences.
learning_standards.3.2.1(iv): Use full stops correctly in sentences.

lessons.title: Laundry chant
lessons.objective: Join the laundry chant vocally at three action-word cues.
lessons.success_criterion: Join the laundry chant vocally at three action-word cues.
lessons.materials: Textbook p. 19; Clean cloth, washing and folding pictures
lessons.induction: Show a clean shirt and a laundry basket; pupils choose a matching action card.
lessons.guided: Model the three laundry actions with the textbook chant at a comfortable pace.
lessons.practice: Pupils select action cards and join the chant on three target-word cues; repeat with a different clothing item.
lessons.support: Use quiet rhythm and accessible movements
lessons.closure: Choose a picture for the last action
lessons.assessment: Count vocal responses at three cues; note adapted non-vocal responses separately.
lessons.reflection_criterion: Join the laundry chant vocally at three action-word cues.
lessons.standard_audit: Textbook teacher-note codes on pages 19–42 checked against the previously reviewed DSKP English standard dictionary; text extracted on 2026-11-26; fresh DSKP page images unavailable. Activities reviewed and adapted independently.

lessons.title: Clothing vocabulary
lessons.objective: Answer five of six spoken Wh-questions about clothes.
lessons.success_criterion: Answer five of six spoken Wh-questions about clothes.
lessons.materials: Textbook p. 20; Clean clothing samples, picture cards
lessons.induction: Reveal a hat from a bag
lessons.guided: Model naming clothing and asking what a person wears
lessons.practice: Ask six oral questions about clothing type or what a person is wearing. Pupils answer with speech or a picture choice.
lessons.support: Allow a word card or two clothing choices
lessons.closure: Name an item suitable for school
lessons.assessment: Count correct answers to the six oral questions.
lessons.reflection_criterion: Answer five of six spoken Wh-questions about clothes.
lessons.standard_audit: Textbook teacher-note codes on pages 19–42 checked against the previously reviewed DSKP English standard dictionary; text extracted on 2026-11-26; fresh DSKP page images unavailable. Activities reviewed and adapted independently.

lessons.title: Reading clothing descriptions
lessons.objective: Read and match four of five short clothing descriptions to pictures.
lessons.success_criterion: Read and match four of five short clothing descriptions to pictures.
lessons.materials: Textbook p. 21; Character pictures, word tiles
lessons.induction: Match a shirt to a character
lessons.guided: Model replacing a picture with a printed clothing word
lessons.practice: Pupils use printed clothing words to replace picture cues in five original descriptions, then match each description to an outfit.
lessons.support: Use a two-word bank for each blank
lessons.closure: Read one completed description
lessons.assessment: Check four of five reading matches.
lessons.reflection_criterion: Read and match four of five short clothing descriptions to pictures.
lessons.standard_audit: Textbook teacher-note codes on pages 19–42 checked against the previously reviewed DSKP English standard dictionary; text extracted on 2026-11-26; fresh DSKP page images unavailable. Activities reviewed and adapted independently.

lessons.title: Colour and clothing sentences
lessons.objective: Write three of four missing clothing words legibly with correct spelling.
lessons.success_criterion: Write three of four missing clothing words legibly with correct spelling.
lessons.materials: Textbook p. 22; Outfit cards, sentence frames
lessons.guided: Model selecting a word using the outfit picture
lessons.practice: Pupils inspect four outfit pictures and write the missing clothing words in the original sentence frames.
lessons.support: Offer colour and clothing word banks
lessons.closure: Read one completed sentence
lessons.assessment: Check word choice, spelling and legibility for four responses.
lessons.reflection_criterion: Write three of four missing clothing words legibly with correct spelling.

lessons.title: One item and many items
lessons.objective: Write four of five suitable singular or plural clothing words legibly.
lessons.success_criterion: Write four of five suitable singular or plural clothing words legibly.
lessons.materials: Textbook p. 23; Toy clothes, number cards
lessons.induction: Show one hat and three hats
lessons.guided: Model selecting the word form for one or more than one
lessons.practice: Pupils match five pictures showing one or several items to a word choice, then write the chosen word in the sentence frame.
lessons.support: Provide paired singular/plural cards
lessons.closure: Show a plural item and read its label
lessons.assessment: Count responses with suitable number form, spelling and legibility.
lessons.reflection_criterion: Write four of five suitable singular or plural clothing words legibly.

lessons.title: Paper clothing craft
lessons.objective: Create a labelled clothing collage using a folded paper shirt and at least two attached details.
lessons.success_criterion: Create a labelled clothing collage using a folded paper shirt and at least two attached details.
lessons.materials: Textbook p. 24; Prefolded paper, crayons, labels
lessons.guided: Model a paper-shirt fold, attach it to card, and add paper pockets or buttons and a label.
lessons.practice: Pupils fold or use an adapted pre-folded shirt, attach it and two details to a backing, then add a readable label.
lessons.support: Offer a precut shape if folding is difficult
lessons.closure: Display the labelled work
lessons.assessment: Check the attached elements and the label; note folding support separately.
lessons.reflection_criterion: Create a labelled clothing collage using a folded paper shirt and at least two attached details.
lessons.source_note: Adaptation adds a collage element to meet DSKP 3.3.1(ii); original textbook craft retained.

lessons.title: Colour questions

lessons.support: Use high-contrast samples and verbal descriptions where appropriate
lessons.closure: Choose a favourite colour
lessons.assessment: Count correct oral-question responses independently of colour matching.
lessons.reflection_criterion: Answer four of five spoken colour questions correctly.

lessons.title: Traditional clothing dialogue

lessons.success_criterion: Match three of four written colour descriptions and answer three of four spoken true/false statements.
lessons.materials: Textbook p. 26–27; Outfit pictures, textbook
lessons.guided: Read the textbook dialogue with picture support and identify colours of traditional garments.
lessons.practice: Pupils match four original written descriptions to clothing pictures. Teacher reads four different statements aloud; pupils indicate true or false.
lessons.support: Provide character-colour cue cards
lessons.closure: Read one character's line
lessons.assessment: Record the two scores separately.
lessons.reflection_criterion: Match three of four written colour descriptions and answer three of four spoken true/false statements.

lessons.title: Food story comprehension
lessons.objective: Read and match two food-related phrases and answer two of three spoken questions.
lessons.success_criterion: Read and match two food-related phrases and answer two of three spoken questions.

lessons.practice: Pupils match two printed phrases to story pictures; teacher asks one yes/no and two Wh-questions orally about the story.
lessons.support: Offer two alternatives and reread one sentence
lessons.closure: Choose a food from the story
lessons.assessment: Record reading matches and listening answers separately.
lessons.reflection_criterion: Read and match two food-related phrases and answer two of three spoken questions.

lessons.success_criterion: Read one short juice request and copy two menu words legibly.

lessons.title: Following food preparation directions

lessons.guided: Model mixing, adding, stirring and serving using pretend ingredients. Give one oral direction at a time.
lessons.practice: Pupils take turns as helper and listener, carrying out four spoken directions; use pretend food by default.
lessons.support: Use picture cues and accessible utensils; real food only after allergy and hygiene checks
lessons.closure: Retell one step using a picture
lessons.assessment: Count three correctly followed directions; record verbal and visual prompts.
lessons.reflection_criterion: Respond to three of four spoken preparation instructions in order.

lessons.title: Number display craft
